example_limits: Original product-card Template View with three complete files: trusted product.html, standard-library Python preparation/renderer, and demo. Nonblank raw names and nonnegative whole stock counts excluding booleans become display strings. A fixed template is loaded once relative to view.py; each rendering call makes a fresh HTML-escaped mapping and strict string.Template substitution. All markers are HTML text. Missing availability fails before a buffered string returns; zero stock is valid and displays Unavailable. Values are not recursively parsed as templates. No Jinja installation, template evaluation language, database, HTTP transport, streaming, dynamic attribute/URL/script context, authorization, rich HTML sanitization, rendered-page cache, or live-stock guarantee is supplied. The order-summary second context is explanatory, not a second runnable implementation.
